wanda-chat-welcometext: Salaan! Waxaan ahay Wanda, kaaliyahaaga AI.
wanda-chat-welcomedesc: I weydii wax kasta oo ku saabsan wikigaaga, waxaana isku dayi doonaa inaan ku caawiyo!
wanda-chat-pdftotext-error: Fadlan hubi in adeegga pdftotext la rakibay oo uu diyaar u yahay in la isticmaalo.
apihelp-wandachat-summary: U dir su'aal ama codsi chatbot-ka kordhinta Wanda
apihelp-wandachat-param-customprompt: Qoraalka tilmaanta ee la adeegsanayo halkii laga isticmaali lahaa tilmaanta caadiga ah
apihelp-wandachat-param-customprompttitl: Cinwaanka bogga wiki-ga ee loo adeegsanayo tusmada tilmaanta gaarka ah
apihelp-wandachat-param-temperature: Heerkulka muunad-qaadista ee loo isticmaalo soo saarista jawaabta (0.0 ilaa 1.0). Qiimayaasha sare waxay soo saaraan jawaabo kala duwanaansho badan leh.
apihelp-wandachat-param-maxtokens: Tirada ugu badan ee calaamadaha jawaabta
apihelp-wandachat-param-model: Qaabka luqadeed ee loo isticmaali doono soo saarista jawaabta
apihelp-wandachat-param-provider: Bixiyaha daruuraha ee loo isticmaali doono qaabka luqadeed
apihelp-wandachat-param-apiendpoint: Barta API-ga gaarka ah ee bixiyaha daruuraha
apihelp-wandachat-param-timeout: Waqtiga ugu badan ee sugitaanka codsiga API-ga, oo lagu cabbirayo ilbiriqsiyo
apihelp-wandachat-param-skipesquery: Haddii laga boodi doono weydiinta Elasticsearch
wanda-api-error-temperature-invalid: Qiimaha heerkulku waa khalad. Fadlan bixi lambar u dhexeeya 0.0 iyo 1.0.
wanda-api-error-temperature-outofrange: Qiimaha heerkulku wuxuu ka baxsan yahay xadka. Fadlan bixi lambar u dhexeeya 0.0 iyo 1.0.
wanda-api-error-config-invalid: Adeegga wada sheekaysigu si sax ah looma habayn. Fadlan la xidhiidh maamule.
wanda-api-error-no-index: Ma helin macluumaad wiki oo khuseeya maadaama aan la helin tusmooyin. Fadlan hubi in nuxurka la sameeyay tusmo.
wanda-api-error-no-results: Ma helin macluumaad khuseeya mawduucaasi gudaha wiki-ga.
wanda-api-error-generation-failed: Waxaan hadda dhibaato kala kulmayaa soo saarista jawaab. Fadlan mar kale isku day.
wanda-api-error-token-limit: Jawaabta waa la soo gaabiyey xadka calaamadaha ($1 tokens) awgiis. Fadlan isku day inaad weydiiso su'aal ka sii gaar ah ama kordhi WandaLLMMaxTokens ee habaynta.
wanda-llm-response-nocontext: Ma haysto macluumaad ku filan oo ku jira macnaha guud ee wiki-ga si aan uga jawaabo taas.
wanda-toggle-public-knowledge-help: Marka la hawlgeliyo, kaaliyuhu waxa uu isticmaali karaa aqoontiisa guud marka lagu daro macnaha guud ee wiki-ga.
wanda-image-search-placeholder-text: Natiijooyinka raadintaada ayaa halkan ka soo muuqan doona
wanda-image-search-error: Khalad ayaa dhacay markii sawirrada la raadinayay. Fadlan mar kale isku day.
wanda-image-too-large: Sawirkani aad buu u weyn yahay. Cabbirka faylka ugu badan waa $1.
wanda-image-limit-reached: Ugu badnaan $1 sawir ayaa la lifaaqi karaa.
apihelp-wandachat-param-images: Liiska magacyada sawirrada ee lagu lifaaqayo oo lagu kala saaray calaamadda tuubada (|) (tusaale, 'File:Example.jpg|File:Image2.png')
apihelp-wandachat-param-conversationhist: Isku-dar JSON ah oo ku qoran fariimihii hore ee wada sheekaysiga, mid kasta oo leh meelaha 'role' iyo 'content'.
wanda-cargo-query-error: Lama soo ceshan karo xog habaysan oo ku saabsan su'aashan.
wanda-cargo-no-tables: Ma jiraan jadwallada Cargo ee diyaar u ah weydiinta.
wanda-cargo-query-failed: Weydiinta xogta habaysan ma soo celin wax natiijo ah.
wanda-cargo-multistep-max-reached: Waxaa la gaaray tirada ugu badan ee tallaabooyinka weydiinta Cargo ($1).
